digest.component_or_area: Jira family reconciler rich-text sync (Cloud ADF + DC wiki)
propositions: Cloud must encode Markdown descriptions and comments as structured ADF (not plain-text paragraphs) through production codec paths and maintain idempotent round-trip conversion.

Data Center must render safe Markdown descriptions and comments as native Jira wiki markup through a segmenting pandoc-based renderer, with fallback to identity when pandoc is unavailable or times out.

Bidirectional sync must prevent echo loops and concurrent-edit conflicts using per-binding baselines (ADR-0026), change-gated content hashes, last-write-wins comparison, and origin-gating to preserve Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates).
Comment creation and updates must use append-only persistent mappings between local and Jira comment IDs and route through the same rich-text codec as descriptions without data loss on edit/delete.

Live cutover must verify that unchanged reconciliation passes add zero committed-state entries, that second passes compute no body updates, and that rendered HTML reads correctly via Jira's expand=renderedFields.

Marked critical defects: DC create path must render like the update path (two create flows both require fit_outbound→to_wire); inbound differ must suppress echo markers to prevent silent re-emit of reconciler-echo comments.
